title: Standard equipment enters Maintenance status upon rental end date
gherkin:
Feature: Post-rent maintenance handling
  Scenario: Standard equipment transitions to Maintenance status at rental end
    Given a rental agreement for standard equipment (non-Concrete Mixer)
    When the rental end date is reached
    Then the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
    And the equipment shall be marked as non-rentable during the maintenance period
rationale: Validates the core requirement that upon reaching the rental end date, the system transitions equipment to 'Maintenance' status. This is the primary lifecycle state change for post-rent handling.
usedContextItems: Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'|Maintenance windows block rental activity and make items appear non-rentable during the maintenance period

Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
